description: Address code review findings: dashboard localhost binding, observability bounds, auto-fetch immediate first fetch and exponential backoff, and WebSocket cleanup.
steps: Step 1 - Dashboard bind to localhost: Add host option to DashboardConfig (default '127.0.0.1'), use it in server.listen()
Step 2 - Observability bounds: Add maxCompletedSpans (default 1000) and maxHistogramSamples (default 10000) constructor options with eviction
Step 3 - Auto-fetch immediate first fetch: Call fetchSource immediately in startSource()
Step 4 - WebSocket cleanup: Add close() method to destroy all clients, clean up destroyed sockets in broadcast()
Step 5 - Auto-fetch exponential backoff: Add per-source backoff multiplier, 2x factor, 5x cap, reset on success
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit passes with no type errors
All existing tests continue to pass
New tests cover bounded spans/histograms, immediate fetch, backoff behavior, and WebSocket cleanup
